items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Yardbird and all the guys in jazz that knew about the Ernie Fields band

ctx.x: that he could maybe turn national and he came to Kansas City again, and so while he was around Kansas City, he looked and he hadn't run into anything and asked some questions, and so somebody asked him if he ever heard of Ernie Fields' band. And he told him no. He said, is that a band here? He said no but he has a mighty fine band. So he said, where is he? He said he's an Oklahoma band, I think his headquarters are Tulsa, Oklahoma. He just comes in here and plays now and then.

So Hammond got to talking around and of course Yardbird and all the guys in jazz that knew about the Ernie Fields band because I had outstanding men, Luther West and all, they hung out together and all the bands and they would tell him that he's in Tulsa, Oklahoma. So Hammond comes to Tulsa.
He went to the Club Lido, a club in Tulsa and he got in touch with one of the waiters and wanted to know if he knew Ernie Fields and they told him yes, they knew Ernie,
